A little more clarity

Questions from parents and educators.

Need more information? Talk to our team.

Who is AaloPro for?

AaloPro is designed for primary and secondary students, with affordable tutoring aligned to local school curriculums.

What is the difference between AaloApp and AaloDot?

AaloApp brings an AI tutor to your phone. AaloDot is our planned voice activated learning companion, designed for learning without a screen.

Can students learn without internet?

Offline learning is central to AaloPro. Both products are designed to make learning support accessible when internet access is limited.

Which curriculums does AaloApp cover?

Explore Bangla Primary and Bangla Secondary for Bangladesh, and SG Primary for Chinese, English and Mathematics in Singapore.

How much does AaloApp cost?

Published pricing is US$1 per month for Primary and US$2 per month for Secondary. App store links are coming soon.

When will AaloDot be available?

AaloDot is a planned product targeting early 2027. Planned pricing is US$39 for Primary and US$49 for Secondary.
